_about: Sunday 4 Oct configuration for tools/factory.py. Data only: change this file, not the code; each keeper re-reads it before every start. A 'todo' field marks a value that depends on a teammate's open pull request or on a decision at 08:55. Placeholders: {python} {until} {params} {duel_ticks} {idle_ticks} {config} {date}. Gates doors_open and clock_running default to true; only the keyless feed and the watchdog opt out. Processes are matched by script basename plus mode token. The dealers are off until PR #35 lands; a dealer step that exits non-zero, or exits 0 without a deal or nothing-to-do marker max_attempts times (default 3), is not relaunched. Dealer commands come from section 7 of the Saturday dealer audit.
todo_notify_cmd: Set to the Mini's send-only Telegram notifier as an argv list, e.g. ["/opt/homebrew/bin/python3", "<path>/projects/telegram-bot/notify.py"]; the alert text is appended as the last argument and it gets no secrets from the factory, so it must read its own token. Path and CLI not verified from this repo.
